title: Pipe band width (×2.2) formula restated in four draw sites instead of one shared helper
evidence: app/render/view.odin:290 `band := width * 2.2`; view.odin:668 `width := base_w * 2.2 - 2.0 * lane_gutter(v) * v.scale`; view.odin:799 `halo := width * 2.2 + 6 * v.scale // 7.1: the selection halo hugs the WIDE band`; app/render/crisis.odin:143 `band := (tier_pipe_width(v, bundles.bundle_tier[b]) + f32(max(0, int(bundles.bundle_count[b])-1))*BUNDLE_EXTRA_WIDTH) * v.scale * 2.2`
detail: The ×2.2 band scale plus the tier+count base-width formula are copied into four draws. The PR single-sourced lane_gutter for exactly this drift risk; editing one copy silently desyncs riders/halo/outline from the drawn band.
recommended_fix: Extract bundle_band_width(v, tier, count) -> f32 beside lane_gutter in view.odin; consume it from draw_bundles, draw_packets, draw_selection, and draw_crisis_outlines.

title: Doorstep queue fan math duplicated inline twice in draw_packets
evidence: view.odin:648 `kx := f32(int(p.id % 5) - 2) * 0.13 * s` / `ky := f32(int((p.id / 5) % 3)) * 0.11 * s` / `pos = {depart.x - 0.80 * s + kx, depart.y + 0.62 * s + ky}`; view.odin:692 (at-node block, comment `// (same fan as the queued-on-edge read above)`) repeats `kx := f32(int(p.id % 5) - 2) * 0.13 * s` / `ky := f32(int((p.id / 5) % 3)) * 0.11 * s` / `pos.x += -0.80 * s + kx`
detail: The fan keyed by packet id is copied into two branches of the same proc; the comment itself points at the other copy. A divergent future edit splits the queued-on-edge and at-node pile visuals.
recommended_fix: Hoist a doorstep_offset(id: u32, s: f32) -> (f32, f32) helper in view.odin and call it from both branches.

title: Crisis-banner y-placement rule still duplicated between app and harness capture
evidence: app/main.odin:1195 `banner_y :: proc(app: ^App) -> i32 {` / `if app.state.health_enabled {` / `return 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6`; harness/goldens.odin:68 `banner_y: i32 = 10` / `if health_on {` / `banner_y = 10 + rnd.HEALTH_CARD_H + 6`
detail: The health-meter banner offset exists as two independent copies (app proc vs harness capture inline). They agree today; a one-sided spacing edit desyncs T2 goldens and the app's alerts-as-nav hit-test from the app's drawn banner.
recommended_fix: Export banner_y(v: ^View, health_on: bool) -> i32 from app/render beside crisis_banner_rect and HEALTH_CARD_H; consume it from main.odin and harness/goldens.odin capture_frame.

title: New SLA/banner hit-tests precede popover_click, breaking the popover-first swallow where they overlap
evidence: app/main.odin:716 `if crisis_banner_click(app, pos) {` / `return true` / `}` / `if sla_focus_click(app, pos) {` / `return true` / `}` / `if popover_click(app, pos) {`; app/render/popover.odin:34 `TRAY_CLEAR :: f32(46)` (popover bottom clamped to win_h-46); app/main.odin:1236 `return v.win_h - 80 + i32(line) * 16` (SLA hit rows span win_h-82..win_h-32 at x 12..732)
detail: sla_focus_click now outranks popover_click. A bottom-clamped popover's demolish button (bottom 36px) sits inside the SLA row hit rects, so a click there toggles class focus instead of demolishing — during the zoom ease this transiently breaks the popover-first contract.
recommended_fix: In effect_ui_press, test popover_click before the banner/SLA clicks, or subtract the open popover_rect from the sla_focus_click / crisis_banner_click hit rects.
